name: ProductManager component system test plan
deployment: PiSensor full system deployment plus the harness component sysTester (the project's base deployment); images prototype (TCP) and flight (RFM69)

not_covered_ack: File system error branches (FileSystemError) and the queue-overflow hooks cannot be forced on the bench without breaking test-as-you-fly: unit tests cover them.
Time-out branches (PICTURE_TIMEOUT, WRITTEN_TIMEOUT), the camera-failure and storage-failure branches: covered by unit tests here and by the project plan's L5 tests.
The start-up scan removing a partial product: covered by a unit test and by the project plan's L3-3 and L3-4.
coverage.rationale: Baselines of the skill, applied to Components/ProductManager only. The on-target figure counts this plan's run together with nothing else; the coverage-dump component is in the development-campaign image only.

final_state.accepted_evidence: bench sha256sum of the L7-1 product file, taken over ssh after the run into record/raw/final-state.txt, compared by the auditor with the hash of the sysTester.Sha256 event
final_state.rationale: The on-board hash command runs inside the UUT process; the bench reads the file itself, outside the UUT's reporting path.

scope: L0: desk-checked; bench confirmation pending. Marker `sysTester.MARK(U32)` -> event `sysTester.Marker(id)`, ids 1000 to 1051 (the project plan uses 10 to 231). Event rate: at most 5 events per second in any window; `LIST_PRODUCTS` emits at most 4 `ProductStored` events per second by design.
- UUT: component `PiSensor::ProductManager`, instance `productManager`, in the PiSensor deployment on the Raspberry Pi 5 `soakee`, 64-bit Raspberry Pi OS 13.

- Test deployment: the project's base deployment plus `sysTester` (SSDD decision D13), the configuration of the project plan `SystemTester/test/int/plan.json`; its scope lines on the ground system, record content, completeness and clocks apply unchanged.

- This plan holds the component rows the project plan delegates (`delegated: prodmgr`): REQ-PiSensor-011, -014, -030, -032, -033, -041, and the one requirement of the component verified by integration test (REQ-ProductManager-015). Every other requirement is verified by the unit-test list of the SDD.

- `sysTester` commands used: `MARK(id)`, `LIST_DIR(dir)`, `DUMP_SHA256(name, pass)`, `CORRUPT_PRODUCT(name)` (planted fault only). `CORRUPT_PRODUCT` overwrites the first two bytes of the picture record and leaves the header, so the file stays a stored product (ledger note N1).

- Order: the prototype block (L0-1 to L2-4, L5-1, L5-2, L6-1 to L6-3, L7-1 last, TCP), then the flight block (L5-3 to L5-6, RFM69). L7-1 runs after the flight block on the prototype image when both blocks run in one record.

- Downlink-in-progress tests run on the flight image: over RFM69 a product takes at least 60 s (project plan link budget), over TCP about a second, too short to send a second command inside the transfer. Each requires a transfer of at least 10 s, else UNVERIFIED.

- Capture-in-progress tests rely on the capture taking longer than one command round trip (SSDD: a capture may take seconds); each requires the second command dispatched before `ProductWritten`, else UNVERIFIED. L0 bench confirmation measures the capture duration.
- Out of scope: product content, timing of metrics, camera, storage, link and restart faults (project plan L2, L3, L5).
entry_gates: - Unit tests of `ProductManager` pass with line coverage at or above the plan's threshold.
- Images built from the base deployment `repo@sha` sent with the DEVELOPMENT stretch plus the component; L0-1 passes on the bench.
- Product directory on its own 64 MB file system, empty at the start of each test (bench teardown removes the products of the test; L7-1 has no teardown).
- Bench recipe: Pi Camera attached; ground Pi with RFM69 for the flight block. Sensors need not answer: metrics are marked invalid and the capture still succeeds.
levels: L0 provenance and feasibility · L2 functional · L5 fault paths · L6 negative controls · L7 final state. No L3 test: restart behaviour of products is in the project plan (L3-1 to L3-4). No L4 endurance test: no requirement has an endurance bound.
not_covered: - Every requirement marked `UT only`: verified by the unit-test list, and at system level by the project plan where it traces a system requirement.
- REQ-ProductManager-046 (name in use): the clock cannot be made to repeat a capture time on the bench without stepping the system clock of a shared machine; unit test only.
- A listing during a listing, a delete during a listing and queue overflow: timing not reachable through the ground link at 5 events per second; unit tests.
- Today's bench cannot run these tests: the camera and the ground Pi are absent.
decision_log: 1. 2026-11-17 designer — the component tests run in the project's base deployment with `sysTester`; no component-only deployment.
2. 2026-11-17 designer — downlink-in-progress tests run on the flight image, where a transfer lasts long enough to command inside it.
3. 2026-11-17 designer — planted faults rewrite or insert commands only; one is `uut-state` (`corrupt_first_product`).

tests.title: Image identity and marker round-trip
tests.purpose: Proves the running image is the manifest's prototype image and the marker round-trips.
tests.setup: Prototype image running on the Raspberry Pi 5; link up.
tests.evidence: Version events equal the manifest describe strings; three Marker events in order, ids byte-exact.

tests.title: Capture names its product
tests.purpose: Proves a successful capture emits ProductWritten naming the one new product file.
tests.setup: Prototype image running, link up, camera answering, product directory empty.

metrics.text: CAPTURE command completion (cmdDisp.OpCodeCompleted of its opcode) - t(productManager.CAPTURE sent) <= 30 s

tests.evidence: check: event productManager.ProductWritten count == 1 (ACTIVITY_HI, names P); check: the sysTester.DirListing event names P and no other file; check: ABS.

tests.title: Second capture leaves the first product unchanged
tests.purpose: Proves a second capture names a new product and leaves the first unchanged.
tests.setup: Prototype image running, link up, camera answering, product directory empty.
tests.evidence: check: event productManager.ProductWritten count == 2 with different names (P1, P2); check: the two sysTester.Sha256 events of P1 are equal; check: the sysTester.DirListing event names P1 and P2 only; check: ABS.

tests.title: Captures around a delete leave the first product unchanged
tests.purpose: Proves captures and a delete of another product leave a stored product unchanged.
tests.setup: Prototype image running, link up, camera answering, product directory empty.
tests.evidence: check: event productManager.ProductWritten count == 3 with three different names (P1, P2, P3); check: event productManager.ProductDeleted count == 1 and names P2; check: the two sysTester.Sha256 events of P1 are equal; check: the sysTester.DirListing event names P1 and P3 only; check: ABS.

tests.title: Delete removes the named product
tests.purpose: Proves DELETE removes the named product and no other, before its command response.
tests.setup: Prototype image running, link up, camera answering, product directory empty.
tests.evidence: check: event productManager.ProductDeleted count == 1 and names P1; check: the sysTester.DirListing event names P2 only; check: the two sysTester.Sha256 events of P2 are equal; check: event productManager.ProductStored count == 1 and names P2; check: event productManager.ProductsListed count == 1 with count 1; check: ABS.

tests.title: Capture during a capture
tests.purpose: Proves a CAPTURE during a capture is rejected and the first capture stores its product.
tests.setup: Prototype image running, link up, camera answering, product directory empty.

metrics.text: CAPTURE command completion (cmdDisp.OpCodeCompleted of its opcode) - t(productManager.CAPTURE sent) <= 30 s

rationale.text: the rejected command fails by design; the window requires STD-ERR (exactly one failed command)

tests.evidence: require (else UNVERIFIED, the race was lost): the second CAPTURE is dispatched before the ProductWritten event. check: event productManager.CommandRejected count == 1 (WARNING_LO, reason CAPTURE_IN_PROGRESS); check: event productManager.ProductWritten count == 1; check: the sysTester.DirListing event names one file, the product named by ProductWritten; check: ABS.

tests.title: Capture after a rejected capture
tests.purpose: Proves a rejected CAPTURE does not disturb the capture in progress or the next one.
tests.setup: Prototype image running, link up, camera answering, product directory empty.

rationale.text: the rejected command fails by design; the window requires STD-ERR (exactly one failed command)

tests.evidence: require (else UNVERIFIED, the race was lost): the second CAPTURE is dispatched before the first ProductWritten event. check: event productManager.CommandRejected count == 1 (reason CAPTURE_IN_PROGRESS); check: event productManager.ProductWritten count == 2 with different names; check: the sysTester.DirListing event names those two files only; check: ABS.

tests.title: Downlink during a downlink
tests.purpose: Proves a DOWNLINK during a downlink is rejected and the first transfer delivers its product.
tests.setup: Flight image running, ground Pi with RFM69 and groundRadio up, camera answering, product directory empty.
procedure: wait CFDP transaction finished at the ground

metrics.text: CFDP transaction duration of the first DOWNLINK from the ground transfer record >= 10 s (require)

rationale.text: the rejected command fails by design; the window requires STD-ERR (exactly one failed command)

tests.evidence: check: event productManager.CommandRejected count == 1 (WARNING_LO, reason DOWNLINK_IN_PROGRESS); check: event productManager.DownlinkStarted count == 1; check: exactly one file arrived and its name is P1; check: sha256 of record/raw/files/<P1> == hash in the sysTester.Sha256 event; check: event productManager.DownlinkComplete count == 1; check: ABS.

tests.title: Repeated downlink of the product in transfer
tests.purpose: Proves a DOWNLINK naming the product in transfer is rejected without a second transfer.
tests.setup: Flight image running, ground Pi with RFM69 and groundRadio up, camera answering, product directory empty.
procedure: wait CFDP transaction finished at the ground

metrics.text: CFDP transaction duration of the first DOWNLINK from the ground transfer record >= 10 s (require)

rationale.text: the rejected command fails by design; the window requires STD-ERR (exactly one failed command)

tests.evidence:
check: event productManager.CommandRejected count == 1 (reason DOWNLINK_IN_PROGRESS); check: exactly one CFDP transaction at the ground, finished complete; check: sha256 of record/raw/files/

== hash in the sysTester.Sha256 event; check: ABS.

tests.title: Delete during the product's downlink
tests.purpose: Proves a DELETE of the product in transfer is rejected and the product is delivered and kept.
tests.setup: Flight image running, ground Pi with RFM69 and groundRadio up, camera answering, product directory empty.
procedure: wait CFDP transaction finished at the ground

metrics.text: CFDP transaction duration of the first DOWNLINK from the ground transfer record >= 10 s (require)

rationale.text: the rejected command fails by design; the window requires STD-ERR (exactly one failed command)

tests.evidence:
check: event productManager.CommandRejected count == 1 (WARNING_LO, reason PRODUCT_IN_DOWNLINK); check: event productManager.ProductDeleted count == 0; check: sha256 of record/raw/files/

== hash in the first sysTester.Sha256 event; check: the two sysTester.Sha256 events are equal; check: the sysTester.DirListing event names P; check: ABS.

tests.title: Delete after the product's downlink
tests.purpose: Proves a DELETE rejected during the downlink succeeds once the transfer has ended.
tests.setup: Flight image running, ground Pi with RFM69 and groundRadio up, camera answering, product directory empty.
procedure: wait CFDP transaction finished at the ground

metrics.text: CFDP transaction duration of the first DOWNLINK from the ground transfer record >= 10 s (require)

rationale.text: the rejected command fails by design; the window requires STD-ERR (exactly one failed command)

tests.evidence: check: event productManager.CommandRejected count == 1 (reason PRODUCT_IN_DOWNLINK) and it precedes event productManager.DownlinkComplete; check: event productManager.ProductDeleted count == 1 and it follows DownlinkComplete; check: the sysTester.DirListing event names no file; check: ABS.

tests.title: Downlink of a missing product
tests.purpose: Proves a DOWNLINK naming no stored product is rejected and nothing is sent.
tests.setup: Prototype image running, link up, camera answering, product directory empty.

rationale.text: the rejected command fails by design; the window requires STD-ERR (exactly one failed command)

tests.evidence: check: event productManager.ProductNotFound count == 1 (WARNING_LO, names Dp_missing.fxd); check: event productManager.DownlinkStarted count == 0; check: no CFDP transaction starts at the ground in the window; check: file names and count of the two sysTester.DirListing events are equal; check: ABS.

tests.title: Delete of a missing product
tests.purpose: Proves a DELETE naming no stored product is rejected and removes nothing.
tests.setup: Prototype image running, link up, camera answering, product directory empty.

rationale.text: the rejected command fails by design; the window requires STD-ERR (exactly one failed command)

tests.evidence: check: event productManager.ProductNotFound count == 1 (names Dp_missing.fxd); check: event productManager.ProductDeleted count == 0; check: file names and count of the two sysTester.DirListing events are equal; check: ABS.

tests.title: Delete with a path as name
tests.purpose: Proves a DELETE whose name is a path to a stored product is rejected and removes nothing.
tests.setup: Prototype image running, link up, camera answering, product directory empty.

rationale.text: the rejected command fails by design; the window requires STD-ERR (exactly one failed command)

tests.evidence: check: event productManager.ProductNotFound count == 1; check: event productManager.ProductDeleted count == 0; check: file names and count of the two sysTester.DirListing events are equal; check: ABS.

tests.title: Final state
tests.purpose: Leaves one known product on board for the independent final-state check.
tests.setup: Prototype image running, link up, camera answering, product directory empty.
tests.evidence: check: event productManager.ProductWritten count == 1 (names P); the DirListing event names P only. After the run the bench runs sha256sum on the product file over ssh into record/raw/final-state.txt; the auditor compares it with the hash of the Sha256 event.
